title: Causal State-Space Model for Causal Inference: Estimating Longitudinal Individual Treatment Effects
abstract: arXiv:2608.08288v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Estimating counterfactual outcomes over time from longitudinal observational data is central to clinical decision support. Existing methods rely on domain confusion -- adversarial training that renders representations invariant to treatment assignment -- yet this invariance creates a mutual information conflict: it suppresses treatment-correlated covariate signals necessary for accurate outcome prediction. We formalise this tension via a Jensen-Shannon divergence bound on counterfactual prediction error and develop two complementary models. CSSD (Causal State-Space model with Direct decoder) adapts selective State Space Models with a parallel multi-step decoder that eliminates accumulated rollout error by producing all prediction horizons simultaneously in a single forward pass. CSSPD (Causal State-Space model with Predictive regularisation and Direct decoder) augments CSSD with Contrastive Predictive Coding and Local Information Max

translated_title: 因果状态空间模型用于因果推断：估计纵向个体治疗效果
translated_abstract: 摘要：从纵向观测数据中估计随时间变化的反事实结果对于临床决策支持至关重要。现有方法依赖于领域混淆——通过对抗训练使表示对治疗分配保持不变——但这种不变性造成了互信息冲突：它抑制了与治疗相关的协变量信号，而这些信号对于准确的结果预测是必要的。我们通过反事实预测误差的Jensen-Shannon散度界限形式化了这一张力，并开发了两个互补模型。CSSD（具有直接解码器的因果状态空间模型）采用选择性状态空间模型和并行多步解码器，通过在一次前向传递中同时生成所有预测时间范围来消除累积展开误差。CSSPD（具有预测正则化和直接解码器的因果状态空间模型）通过对比预测编码和局部信息最大化增强了CSSD。
tldr: 本文提出两种因果状态空间模型（CSSD和CSSPD），通过并行解码器和预测正则化解决因果推断中不变性表示与结果预测之间的互信息冲突，从而提高纵向个体治疗效果的估计准确性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes two causal state-space models (CSSD and CSSPD) that address the mutual information conflict between invariant representations and outcome prediction in causal inference via parallel decoding and predictive regularization, improving the accuracy of longitudinal individual treatment effect estimation.
